description: Edit this sheet of six small chibi pixel art figures sitting on the ground: in the top row one sits facing the viewer, one sits facing away from the viewer, one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the chest; in the bottom row one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the mouth and two sit facing away. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a pumpkin king's, made of a few big bold shapes and no fine pattern: a rounded bright-orange pumpkin doublet that swells a little at the belly, with three broad dark-orange ribs running down it like a pumpkin's, a small collar of teal-green leaves kept below the chin, long deep-violet sleeves to the wrist, a short deep-violet mantle over the shoulders lined in teal-green that ends above the waist, plain dark trousers and black boots. Seen from behind, the short violet mantle covers the shoulders and the orange doublet with its ribs shows below it. Nothing of the outfit reaches lower than each seated figure's own lowest pixels, which stay exactly where they are. The hands stay bare and keep their place. Transparent background, nothing else added.
